decisive_items: Positive for Chikungunya virus with weak viral load (detected by real-time PCR)
Positive IgM CHIKV serologic test (from initial diagnosis)
response.rationale: R4 directly identifies the etiological agent with PCR and IgM, which is the most likely diagnosis. R6 is a manifestation that is incomplete because it labels as uveitis but the case also has keratitis. R1 and R3 are descriptive and lack etiological specificity.

rejected.why: Describes an immune mechanism but does not identify the underlying cause.
No raw support and is a descriptive term without etiological specificity.
